package main

import "fmt"

type Point struct {
	X, Y int
	Tag  string
}

type Inner struct{ A []int }
type Outer struct {
	P  *Point
	I  Inner
	M  map[string]int
	Ok bool
}

func main() {
	p := Point{1, 2, "a"}
	fmt.Printf("%v|%+v|%#v|%T\n", p, p, p, p)
	pp := &p
	fmt.Printf("%v|%+v|%T\n", pp, pp, pp)
	fmt.Println(pp)
	o := Outer{nil, Inner{[]int{1, 2}}, map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1}, true}
	fmt.Printf("%v\n%+v\n", o, o)
	fmt.Printf("%#v\n", []int{1, 2})
	fmt.Printf("%#v %#v\n", map[string]int{"z": 1, "a": 2}, []string{"x"})
	fmt.Printf("%#v %#v %#v %#v\n", 42, "s", 1.5, true)
	var ns []int
	var nm map[string]bool
	fmt.Printf("%#v %#v %v %v\n", ns, nm, ns, nm)
	fmt.Printf("%T %T %T %T %T %T\n", 1, "s", 2.0, 'r', []string{}, map[int]bool{})
	fmt.Printf("%T %T %T\n", nil, fmt.Errorf("e"), struct{}{})
	fmt.Printf("[%5d][%-5d][%05d][%+d][%x][%X][%o][%b][%#x]\n", 42, 42, 42, 42, 255, 255, 8, 5, 255)
	fmt.Printf("[%s][%10s][%-10s][%.2s][%q]\n", "go", "go", "go", "gopher", "a\"b")
	fmt.Printf("[%c][%U][%#U][%q][%x]\n", 'G', 'G', 'é', 'x', "hi")
	fmt.Printf("[%t][%v][%5t]\n", true, false, true)
	fmt.Printf("[%e][%E][%.2e][%f][%.3f][%8.2f][%-8.2f][%08.2f][%g][%G][%.3g]\n", 1234.5678, 1234.5678, 1234.5678, 3.14159, 3.14159, 3.14159, 3.14159, -3.14159, 0.000012345, 1e21, 3.14159)
	fmt.Printf("[%v][%v][%v][%v]\n", 1e6, 1e-7, 123456789.0, 0.1+0.2)
	fmt.Printf("[%6.2f%%]\n", 12.3456)
	fmt.Printf("%d %s\n", "str", 5)
	fmt.Printf("%d\n", 1, 2)
	fmt.Printf("%d %d\n", 1)
	fmt.Printf("%v %d\n", []int{1, 2}, []int{3, 4})
	fmt.Printf("%x %X\n", []byte("hi"), "Hi")
	fmt.Printf("%s\n", []string{"a", "b"})
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", []string{"a", "b"})
	fmt.Printf("%v %v\n", [2]bool{true, false}, struct{ A, B int }{1, 2})
	fmt.Printf("%5.1f|%-6v|%6v\n", 2.25, "ab", 3)
	fmt.Printf("%*d|%-*d|\n", 5, 1, 4, 2)
	var e error
	fmt.Printf("%v\n", e)
	var ip *int
	fmt.Println(ip, nil)
	fmt.Printf("%v %+v\n", []*Point{nil}, Outer{})
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprint("a", 1, 2, "b", "c", 3.5, true))
	fmt.Println(fmt.Sprintln("x", 1) + "|")
	fmt.Printf("%v %v\n", int8(-5), uint8(200))
	fmt.Printf("%08.3f|%+.1e|% d|%x\n", 3.14159, 12345.678, 5, -255)
	fmt.Printf("%3c|%-4q|%#o\n", 'x', 'y', 8)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

type Person struct {
	Name string
	Age  int
}

type ByAge []Person

func (a ByAge) Len() int           { return len(a) }
func (a ByAge) Swap(i, j int)      { a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i] }
func (a ByAge) Less(i, j int) bool { return a[i].Age < a[j].Age }

func main() {
	xs := []int{5, 2, 8, 1, 9, 3}
	sort.Ints(xs)
	fmt.Println(xs)
	ss := []string{"pear", "apple", "fig"}
	sort.Strings(ss)
	fmt.Println(ss)
	people := []Person{{"Alice", 30}, {"Bob", 25}, {"Carol", 35}, {"Dan", 25}}
	sort.Slice(people, func(i, j int) bool { return people[i].Age < people[j].Age })
	fmt.Println(people)
	sort.SliceStable(people, func(i, j int) bool { return people[i].Name > people[j].Name })
	fmt.Println(people)
	i := sort.Search(len(xs), func(i int) bool { return xs[i] >= 5 })
	fmt.Println(i, sort.SearchInts(xs, 8))
	sort.Sort(ByAge(people))
	fmt.Println(people)
	fl := []float64{2.5, -1, 3}
	sort.Float64s(fl)
	fmt.Println(fl, sort.IntsAreSorted(xs))
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.IntSlice(xs)))
	fmt.Println(xs)

	ys := []int{3, 1, 2}
	slices.Sort(ys)
	fmt.Println(ys, slices.Contains(ys, 2), slices.Contains(ys, 7), slices.Index(ys, 3), slices.Index(ys, 9))
	slices.Reverse(ys)
	fmt.Println(ys, slices.Max(ys), slices.Min(ys))
	fmt.Println(slices.Equal(ys, []int{3, 2, 1}), slices.Equal(ys, []int{3, 2}))
	ys = slices.Insert(ys, 1, 10, 11)
	fmt.Println(ys)
	ys = slices.Delete(ys, 0, 2)
	fmt.Println(ys, len(ys))
	words := []string{"Banana", "apple", "Cherry"}
	slices.SortFunc(words, func(a, b string) int { return strings.Compare(strings.ToLower(a), strings.ToLower(b)) })
	fmt.Println(words)
	slices.SortStableFunc(people, func(a, b Person) int { return a.Age - b.Age })
	fmt.Println(people)
	fmt.Println(slices.IndexFunc(xs, func(x int) bool { return x < 3 }), slices.ContainsFunc(xs, func(x int) bool { return x > 100 }))
	idx, found := slices.BinarySearch([]int{1, 3, 5}, 3)
	fmt.Println(idx, found)
	c := slices.Clone(ys)
	c[0] = 99
	fmt.Println(ys[0] != c[0], slices.Compact([]int{1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3}))
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(strconv.Itoa(-45) + "!")
	n, err := strconv.Atoi("123")
	fmt.Println(n+1, err)
	_, err = strconv.Atoi("12a")
	fmt.Println(err)
	_, err = strconv.Atoi("99999999999999999999")
	fmt.Println(err)
	fmt.Println(strconv.FormatInt(255, 16), strconv.FormatInt(-5, 2), strconv.FormatInt(35, 36))
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt("-ff", 16, 64)
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	v, err = strconv.ParseInt("300", 10, 8)
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	v, err = strconv.ParseInt("0x1F", 0, 64)
	fmt.Println(v, err)
	fmt.Println(strconv.Quote("hi \"there\"\n\té"))
	b, err := strconv.ParseBool("true")
	fmt.Println(b, err, strconv.FormatBool(false))
	f, err := strconv.ParseFloat("3.25", 64)
	fmt.Println(f, err)
	fmt.Println(strconv.FormatFloat(3.14159, 'f', 2, 64))
	u, err := strconv.ParseUint("42", 10, 64)
	fmt.Println(u, err)
	_, err = strconv.Atoi("")
	fmt.Println(err)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.Split("a,b,,c", ","))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.Split("abc", ""))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.SplitN("a,b,c", ",", 2))
	fmt.Println(strings.Join([]string{"x", "y", "z"}, "-"))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.Fields("  hello   world \t go\n"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Repeat("ab", 3))
	fmt.Println(strings.Replace("oink oink oink", "k", "ky", 2))
	fmt.Println(strings.Replace("oink oink oink", "oink", "moo", -1))
	fmt.Println(strings.ReplaceAll("banana", "a", "o"))
	fmt.Println(strings.HasPrefix("golang", "go"), strings.HasSuffix("golang", "ng"), strings.HasPrefix("go", "golang"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Index("chicken", "ken"), strings.Index("chicken", "dmr"), strings.LastIndex("go gopher", "go"))
	fmt.Println(strings.IndexByte("golang", 'l'), strings.IndexRune("chicken", 'k'))
	fmt.Println(strings.Contains("seafood", "foo"), strings.ContainsRune("abc", 'b'), strings.ContainsAny("failure", "ui"))
	fmt.Printf("[%s]\n", strings.TrimSpace("  \t hi there \n "))
	fmt.Println(strings.Trim("!!hi!!", "!"), strings.TrimLeft("xxhixx", "x"), strings.TrimRight("xxhixx", "x"))
	fmt.Println(strings.TrimPrefix("prefix-body", "prefix-"), strings.TrimSuffix("file.go", ".go"))
	fmt.Println(strings.Count("cheese", "e"), strings.Count("five", ""))
	fmt.Println(strings.EqualFold("Go", "GO"), strings.ToUpper("hello"), strings.ToLower("HeLLo"))
	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("hello")
	sb.WriteByte(' ')
	sb.WriteRune('w')
	sb.WriteString("orld")
	fmt.Println(sb.String(), sb.Len())
	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "!%d", 42)
	fmt.Println(sb.String())
	b := new(strings.Builder)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		b.WriteString(fmt.Sprint(i))
	}
	fmt.Println(b.String())
	sb.Reset()
	fmt.Println(sb.Len())
	fmt.Println(strings.Compare("a", "b"), strings.ToTitle("go"))
	before, after, found := strings.Cut("key=value", "=")
	fmt.Println(before, after, found)
	fmt.Println(strings.Map(func(r rune) rune { return r + 1 }, "abc"))
	fmt.Println(strings.IndexFunc("ab1c", func(r rune) bool { return r == '1' }))
	fmt.Println(strings.TrimFunc("123abc456", func(r rune) bool { return r >= '0' && r <= '9' }))
}
